This '''system''' contained at least [[Unidentified planet (trinary system)|one planet]].

==Description==
The system had three suns.<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
At some point during his career, [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] visited a [[Unidentified planet (trinary system)|planet]] of this [[Star system/Legends|system]]. After he got some trouble, he fled with a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], but a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] chased him. Garnet unsuccessfully tried to lose the trooper in a canyon, and both driver crashed the bike.<ref name="RPG" />
